integrity: A standalone exact-integer finite checker corroborates representative cases; the all-size results follow from explicit combinatorial arguments. Historical priority and independent scientific review remain unverified.
scientific_limitations: The constructive result assumes at least k exactly-quota-support candidates and no greater supports. Hardness is for variable committee size, quota four and a particular one-exception family; no claim for other quotas, restricted ballots or approximation.
title: One over-quota candidate is enough for hard distinctive-representation elections
